records.rule: Separately reviewed deterministic identity decision recorded in protected crosswalk.
No name, normalized name, OPD/alias, phone, email, DOB, gender, address, Ghana Card alone, fuzzy or weighted matching.
Query unscoped/withTrashed; exactly one live, unmerged target; retain target row/number unchanged.
Quarantine crosswalk; do not allocate replacement automatically.
Quarantine; no scoring or best candidate.
Block controlled review; never restore, follow merge pointer or recycle identity automatically.
Record protected conflict flags only; do not overwrite target fields.

Zero changes to id, number, identity/contact, registered_by, timestamps, status, deleted/merge state, pre-existing aliases or pre-existing children. After link commit, the separate D-201 alias stage may create one new eligible legacy_opd without changing the immutable pre-existing set.
Prohibited unless an explicit reviewed identity decision authorizes it; never inferred from duplicate signals.
Collision is an alias exception, not existing-target identity evidence.
Target unique but source field absent; no inferred value or target link.
Domain-separated HMAC pre/post protected target field groups; any delta stops.

Explicit links map one source/target; patient rows created/updated, numbers changed, and aliases created/reassigned by the existing-link path are zero. A later eligible legacy_opd creation is counted only by PATIENT-REC-ALIAS-002.
